research_notes: Initial research 2026-10-01: frozen roster has no occupations; substantial independent chronology recovered from his published preselection CV, named NAB executive testimonial, first speech, contemporary ABC/InDaily reports and September 2026 radio interview. No roster refresh performed.

Full-time evidence is unusually explicit for direct NAB role. The year-precision 2022–2024 labels support only an approximate gross 1–3-year calendar envelope. This is not a confirmed full-time-years total: start/end months, leave and any subsequent status change remain unknown. No numeric point estimate is inserted in headline fields.

Harvest interruption: interview at 04:10 says he kept October–December free during project consulting and returned to farm, while first speech says he had not missed harvest. Do not subtract exactly three months from every year or every employer without dated evidence; paid annual leave, unpaid leave, contracting gaps and NAB employment may differ. Separately distinguish permanent 2024 farm return, election campaign, and reported missed 2025 harvest.

Control: banking and commercial consultancy employers classified private, with historical corporate reporting linked. Public-sector client projects are not public employment. Exact payroll companies within Capgemini, Deloitte and Accenture remain unverified; no claim that the global brand itself was the legal employer.

Employer/professional avenues: public LinkedIn indexed extract corroborates Deloitte aggregate duration, but search did not expose exact dates. No direct LinkedIn request made after prior cycle source rate response. UK architect and Austrian leadership-coach Tom Venning profiles are different people and not used. NAB shareholder report and historical consultancy filings support control but not personal hours.

Follow-up: payroll entities and appointment/promotion dates; dated full-time NAB contract/status and leave; consulting harvest arrangements; farm payroll versus self-employment and exit; app project pay/entity; mentoring hosts and dates; earlier paid jobs. Do not transfer relatives’ grain-board or parliamentary roles to Tom. Last follow-up 2026-10-01; next Charlotte Walker.

Follow-up2026-10-02: public professional index narrows direct NAB employment to October2022–May2024, superseding broad year-only boundaries. Earlier1–3yeargross envelope is historical and no longer best available precision. Full-time continuity, leave and actual first/last days remain unresolved.

Capgemini indexedJanuary2019senior-consultant entry conflicts with published2016–18CV; retain conflict rather than extend headline or misassign the adjacentDeloitte entry. Targeted app,consultancy andfarm searches returned no reliable new legal employer/pay or leave record. Next seek originalrolehistory and NAB harvest arrangements. Corporate clients remain distinct from employers.

Follow-up2026-10-04: public professional-profile indexing now exposes month-level corporate chronology: Capgemini Consultant July2017–December2018 and Senior Consultant January2019; Deloitte Consultant February2019–December2020 and Consulting Manager December2020–May2022; Accenture May–November2022; NAB October2022–May2024. Displayed transition months overlap and are not exact-day evidence. Hours, leave, employing subsidiaries, the unexplained 2016 Capgemini year and harvest interruptions remain unresolved, so no headline years were calculated.
